description: Every person address a build published: aliases holds each name key (name-<name> and <name>) with the person id it answered with when first published; ids every person id that had a page. Entries are only added (scripts/build/build-person-address-ledger.mjs, after each records build); the Browse build gives each key back to its person through the person-id merges, and the records check fails when a key or id stops answering (scripts/lib/person-address-ledger.mjs).
